items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Is that close where Betty Cole was? That was her place.

ctx.x: I went over it. Yeah, I was a kid when he was playing. I used to play at the Willow Long, up on the Willow between Josephine and Jackson, every Sunday night.
Is that close where Betty Cole was? That was her place.

That's the name of the place, Willow Long. Yeah. That was her place. That's Kornichatsu, then. That's Kornichatsu, then. Mm-hmm. Yeah, that's the name. Yeah, that's it. Yeah, that's it. That's Kornichatsu, then. Mm-hmm. Yeah, that's the name. Yeah, that's it. Yeah, that's it. Risley said he sounded like Buddy.
